description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Mexico Mexico Federal Labour Law mandatory rest days result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when article 69 weekly rest is at least one day after six days and the employer/worker schedule is not inferred; sector, state, employer, school and bank calendars are outside scope.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2027 authority events.
Example user requests: Mexico: Constitution Day observed.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-02-02"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Saturday/Sunday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/mexico-labor-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/mexico-labor-working-day.md
name: check_mx_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Mexico Federal Labour Law mandatory rest days

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_policy.description: Article 74 mandatory rest days; first/third Mondays are represented by their statutory observed dates

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

substitute_day_policy.description: Election-day and six-year executive-transition dates are not inserted without the applicable electoral/constitutional schedule

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Mexico Working Day
